Scoring notes:
• The first point is earned for two steps (of size 0.5) of Euler’s method, with at most one error. If
there is any error, the second point is not earned.
• To earn the first point a response must contain two Euler steps, 0.5 x ∆ = , use of the correct
expression for
dy
dx
, and use of the initial condition ( ) 1 4 f = .
o The two Euler steps may be explicit expressions or may be presented in a table. Here is a
minimal example of a (correctly labeled) table.

o Note: In the presence of the correct answer, such a table does not need to be labeled in order to
earn both points. In the presence of an incorrect answer, the table must be correctly labeled for
the response to earn the first point.
• A single error in computing the approximation of ( ) 1.5 f is not considered a second error if that
incorrect value is imported correctly into an approximation of ( ) 2 f .
• Both points are earned for “ ( ) 4 0.5 4 1.5ln1.5 0 0.5 ⋅ + ⋅ + ⋅ ” or “ ( ) 4 4 1.5ln1.5 0.5 + ⋅ ⋅ ”.
• Both points are earned for presenting the ordered pair ( ) , 4 3ln1.5 2 + with sufficient supporting
work.
